text: ⚠️ Galti: aaj ke skit ke Part 1 aur Part 3 mein '50+ times use' aur 'do baar use' likha tha, ye mana hai. Purane Part 1 aur 3 mat use karo. Ye naye wale lo (Part 2 same rahega):

Shot: Single continuous vertical 9:16 handheld phone video, realistic site meeting, shaky cam. Characters: Contractor and Mason looking at cracked, damaged brown plywood. Dialogue: Contractor: 'Arre bhai, ye ply fir se kharab ho gaya, budget double ho raha hai.' Mason: 'Haan sahab, wazan bhi zyada hai aur jaldi tut jaata hai.' Setting: Busy Indian construction site with scaffolding and dust. Sound: Hammering sounds, distant traffic.

Shot: Single continuous vertical 9:16 handheld phone video, realistic site meeting, stable close shot. Characters: Client, Engineer, and Contractor smiling while touching smooth plain grey PP hollow plastic sheets with no text or logo. Dialogue: Engineer: 'Ye grey PP sheets lagao, sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai, aur finish ekdum mast aayegi.' Contractor: 'Wah, paisa bhi bachega aur kaam bhi fast!' Setting: Indian construction site with neatly stacked grey sheets. Sound: Wind blowing, cheerful ambient site chatter.
